arStrings.szText:
Each point in your Primary Stat increases your Primary Resource by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%+|]{/c} but you have {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"*100|%|]{/c} reduced life. Any damage you would take is dealt to your Primary Resource before your life. 

If you have not taken damage in {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds, your Resource regenerates to full over {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} seconds.
